verdict.rationale: Superpowers skills are SKILL.md folders treated as harness-agnostic and shared verbatim by every harness; porting never edits SKILL.md files. Codex, Copilot CLI and Gemini CLI recognize the cross-runtime `~/.agents/skills/` path. A hands-on probe installed a skill through the generic `npx skills add` installer and read back clean SKILL.md frontmatter. Evals also run the same skills across Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI. Missing for 10: no explicit documented statement of conformance to the open Agent Skills specification, and no validator or spec-compliance check; full auto-triggering on a new harness still needs a separate bootstrap injector and per-harness install.
